annotations.title: Check a lens against engineering requirements

description: Start with the sensor dimensions and a shortlisted optical part number. Check FoV ranges, image-circle coverage, nominal mount and axis-specific calculated distortion using the existing live FoV backend. Explicitly report unknown mass/dimensions without source units and missing engineering evidence. No fixture lens substitution, recalculated optics, product qualification or purchase action.

lens_sku.description: Exact optical part number from search/matching, e.g. CIL353; not an inferred Shopify configuration.

pixelSizeUm.description: Custom sensor: pixel pitch in microns (e.g. 1.55).

full_sensor_coverage.description: Require the image circle to cover the full sensor diagonal. Does not establish edge image quality.

max_diameter_mm.description: Unknown unless the source explicitly supplies millimetres. Does not establish rear clearance.

max_weight_g.description: Unknown unless the source explicitly supplies grams; unitless numbers are not interpreted.

mount.description: M12/S-mount, C-mount/C FA, or CS-mount. Nominal interface only; does not establish mechanical fit.

require_evidence.description: Request engineering confirmation. These structured datasets are not currently supplied by the public backend contract.

sensor.description: Sensor part number. Alternatively provide custom dimensions, not both.

sensorHeightMm.description: Custom sensor: active-area height in mm.

sensorWidthMm.description: Custom sensor: active-area width in mm (alternative to pixels x pitch).

widthPx.description: Custom sensor: horizontal pixel count (e.g. 4056). Use with heightPx and pixelSizeUm.

name: assess_lens_requirements
